notes: Modified cash basis village (recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds 2024 column (p6; labels on p5). 'Taxes' 493,425 split from the General Fund schedule (p10: Property tax 477,617 + Motor vehicle tax 15,808); 'Intergovernmental revenues' 198,640 split from the fund schedules (p10-11: Highway allocation 91,196, Motor vehicle fees 6,449, Homestead allocation 10,052, Other 90,943). Bond issue costs, bond principal and bond interest payments are printed under Other financing sources (uses), below Total expenditures, so they are disbursements with outside_printed_total. Governmental transfers out 557,394 = governmental in 421,633 + proprietary in 135,761. Business-type (Water and Sewer combined; no per-fund proprietary statement) from p8; total disbursements 427,446 = operating 385,443 + interest/fees 42,003, printed as Total business-type activities expenses on p2. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals 2024 column (p1), because it includes capital assets and long-term debt. ending_investments = governmental certificates of deposit 829,727 (p4 Totals), informational. Detail: per-fund statements for the major funds (p10-11) and non-major funds (p12-13), plus the proprietary budgetary comparison actual column (p15). Zero-amount lines omitted. The combined budget statement (p14) prints only governmental/proprietary totals and is not recorded (would double count). Read pages 1-15 of 15.
